questions.question: BIOS boots when?
questions.explanation: Magic checked, sector loaded to 0x7C00, jumped.

questions.question: cli first because?
options: No stack yet: interrupt would push into garbage

questions.question: -Ttext 0x7c00 needed because?
options: $msg must equal runtime addr (loaded at 0x7C00, DS=0)
questions.explanation: Without origin, SI points 0x7C00 low (classic first-boot bug).

questions.question: Dual output (VGA+serial) why?
options: Humans read screen, CI reads wire (nographic shows serial)

questions.question: Oversize code (>510) does what?
questions.explanation: Budget enforced at assemble time, not boot time.
